rule: Sample rule (231 section 2): per evaluation set (ESCI test300, TREC-DL 2019, TREC-DL 2020) the queries are sorted ascending by SHA256('231:' + canonical_query_id) (canonical id = str(query key of the stored score file: ESCI 'nq', TREC the query id string); utf-8), taken in that order until the cumulative number of evaluated pairs first reaches >= 600; all pairs of the last query are kept. Pair order inside the sample: query order above, then pair ids sorted as in the stored score files. The first 64 pairs of this order are the FP32-reference subset (may end inside a query). If only one class is present, further queries would be added in the same order (not needed).
